lines.text: The angel says the words are faithful and true, and Jesus says He is coming soon.
John falls at the angel's feet to worship him, but the angel says to worship God.
John is told to seal up the words of prophecy because the time is near, and Jesus brings His reward.

wrong_details.wrong: to seal up the words of prophecy
wrong_details.true: Do not seal up the words of prophecy

lines.text: Those who wash their robes may enter the city, and Jesus calls Himself the Root of Saul.

wrong_details.true: the Root and the Offspring of David

lines.text: The thirsty are invited to drink the water of life, and the book ends with grace for all the saints.
